text:
incident-bot: ALERT: tenant=harvest-fin (dedicated-us-west-2) — 5xx spike + p50 latency x3. Pager -> @sre-oncall. Incident ID INC-2026-0421-17

maria.k: taking pager, oncall here. any idea on customer impact?

devon: errors mostly decode-timeouts from gs-l1-quant, KV cache miss rate jumped. started ~00:13 UTC, affects ~40% of requests for harvest-fin.

ashraf: harvest-fin is enterprise VPC on dedicated pool; they do not have auto-fallback configured. we should consider pinning to safe variant (gs-l1-safe-v2) while we triage.

maria.k: agree. plan: 1) shadow-pin to safe variant for a short window, 2) if good, do live tenant pin, 3) monitor for 10m and rollback if regressions. @account-eng please prep customer comms.

account-eng: will draft now and post to Harvest support channel + call their infra lead. CSM @cs-lena standing by.

maria.k: running shadow pin (non-traffic shadow) to gs-l1-safe-v2 now to validate. logs streaming: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/harvest-fin/actions/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gs-l1","variant":"gs-l1-safe-v2","mode":"shadow"}'```

devon: shadow results after 3m: error_rate down ~78%, p50 latency back to baseline. KV miss also reduced. looks promising.

maria.k: proceeding with live pin now. executing control-plane pin (will announce when done). rolling window monitor set to 10m.

incident-bot: ACTION: PIN_REQUEST issued for tenant=harvest-fin by maria.k at 1767779902

maria.k: PIN_SUCCESS — tenant harvest-fin pinned to gs-l1-safe-v2. monitoring 10m.

ashraf: good. filing follow-up to add auto-fallback policy: trigger -> variant fallback to safe when 5xx_rate > 2% for 5m for dedicated pools. ticket created: INFRA-1429.

account-eng: customer notified, they acknowledged and paused non-critical batch jobs. CSM @cs-lena confirmed no SLA breach expected now.

devon: continuing to watch metrics; no regression in next 10m. will start post-incident trace to find root cause of KV miss and decode delays.

maria.k: postmortem owner and action items: 1) implement auto-fallback rule for enterprise/dedicated tenants, 2) add continuous shadow test harness for safe-variants, 3) investigate KV cache pressure leading to misses. assigning follow-ups in INFRA board. closing incident thread after stability window. :white_check_mark:

cs-lena: thanks team — I'll coordinate customer follow-up + timeline for change controls.

incident-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED (monitoring): INC-2026-0421-17 closed at 1767780450
